audit.why: Mordekaiser from level 2 through first item with Akali reclaiming at two items matches 51.17% Emerald+ over 665 games and both on-disk charts. Charts untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes read 'Realm of Death online, level 6, first item' for him and 'levels 2-3 (full pattern)' for Akali, with no numbers on either side.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is not learnable before level 3, so Akali's first spike is 3. Mordekaiser's real early spike is Darkness Rise turning on at three attacks or spells landed, and Realm of Death is 140/120/100s - the single longest cooldown in the lane and the only one worth building a plan around.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes, phases[0].why and phases[4].why rebuilt on Darkness Rise, level 3 and the 140s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Death's Grasp is never described anywhere in the full layer beyond the words 'his E pull', and no ability in this matchup carried a cooldown number.
audit.why: Death's Grasp pulls all enemies in an area on 16/14/12/10/8s from 700 range. That pull is what sets up the isolated Obliterate the content layer correctly identifies as his best trade - so the pull, not the ultimate, is the first thing you dodge. Obliterate is 8/7/6/5/4s, Indestructible is 12/11/10/9/8s and can be consumed as a heal, and Realm of Death is 140/120/100s.
audit.corrected: tldr, report[0].t, winCon, report[1].t, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t, report[9].t, report[11].t, dontsFull[1].t and content wants.foe[0] now carry Death's Grasp and the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] is titled 'Build MR' but its body was the generic Q-poke trade line copied from breakdown.trading.
audit.why: Obliterate, Darkness Rise and Realm of Death are all magic damage, so armour is dead gold in this lane and the entry never said so. Anti-heal is already correctly present in report[8] because Indestructible converts the stored shield into a heal.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now states Mercury's Treads and MR first, and why armour buys nothing.
